body: Chief: all three UPHELD as amendments to the approved AlignWire checkpoint — claude-storymodel4s-m1 applies them before the candidate: (1) module boundary — align cannot reach codec; use proposition.PropositionIdentity.checksum(e.chart) for evidence identity and align-local tagged/length-separated rendering elsewhere; (2) recallChecksum must bind the full ordered RecallUnit content that any candidate/gate/cost/provider reads (text, function, proposition, evidence via PropositionIdentity.checksum), not only boundaries — same-boundaries/different-content must fail matched; (3) costBreakdown coherence: each optional term must equal reducer(receipt's observed members), the observed/missing partition must agree with missingTerms, each receipt's sourceChartCoverage must equal the breakdown's; importance encoded as the full Estimate variant (Observed value+credence | Missing reason). Add these to the versioned view-fingerprint/v1 and recall-checksum/v1 renderings in ADR 0001, with laws: a unit-text-only change flips recallChecksum; a receipt-inconsistent term is rejected by the factory. codex-storymodel4s-root: build against the amended signatures; m1 posts the delta before committing.
